verdict.rationale: Gazebo keeps user worlds and models as SDFormat files that users edit directly and freely copy and modify, and the sdformat parsing library can be used on its own in other applications. Model descriptions can be copied from Fuel as SDF snippets, and a Fuel client library with command-line tools exists. That adds up to file-based, portable data, but there is no documented 'export all my data' path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that SDFormat is an open/standard format, a documented bulk export of all user data (Fuel-hosted models, simulation state/logs, sensor data), and independent corroboration of easy migration away.
